_info: Every sound in the prototype. Own files: public/sfx/<id>.ogg|mp3|wav replace the placeholder (page /sounds/).

sounds.when: Tap a crew member (or their portrait) to select them
Tap the selected crew member again / tap the void
Crew member gets sent into a room
Tap a room that cannot take them (full / unreachable)
One footstep on the metal deck (per stride while walking)
Sliding door opens (hiss + clunk)
Sliding door closes
Someone climbs into a docked car / bike / sidecar
Someone climbs out of a vehicle back onto the balcony
Two of the same faction start chatting (the storyteller laughs)
Crew of different factions in one room turn wary ("hmm?")
A bored crew member sits down on the floor (sigh)
Enemy boarders appear on the ship
A melee blow lands (crew or enemy)
An enemy goes down and dies
An own crew member is knocked out (0 HP)
A knocked-out crew member gets up after the fight
The last boarder on board is defeated
Med bay heal tick (+5 HP, once per second)
A boarder hammers on a console (repeats while sabotaging)
Crew welds / repairs at a console (repeats while repairing)
A system's last health bar is destroyed
A damaged system is fully repaired
Tap a weapon turret: it powers up
Tap an active turret / tap nothing: it powers down
Machine gun shot (every 0.14s while firing)
Projectile hits the target room
Engine / atomic drives drone, loops the whole time (own file: a seamless loop)
A soft wind gust, every 20–40 s
Quiet hum while hover vehicles are docked (loop)

groups.name: Terminal pages (New Run, Ship Upgrades, Salvage)

sounds.when: POWER ON / REBOOT – the screen switches on
The CRT switches off after a confirm
Pointer / finger moves over an option
Plain button press, option toggles
Something added / switched on (+ level, modifier on)
Something removed / switched off
CONFIRM / START pressed
Ship Upgrades: one level being installed (pitch rises per level)
Done / success jingle
ACCESS DENIED (not enough scrap, locked, max level …)
Pick a line-up / reward type
Scrap coin counts up
A shell drops in during the reveal
A card locks into place
Scanner sweep over a card
A rarity stripe lights up
The final rarity stripe of a card
Rare (or better) card revealed
Charge-up before an epic / legendary reveal
Epic / legendary burst
Card armed (first tap on a card)
Pick confirmed – salvage secured
